scope: Phase A development diagnostic only. Not a candidate freeze, an L1-L6 pass/fail, H1/H2 evaluation or evidence for enabling motion.
stream: Actual ECM 640x480 only, same RGB-D preprocessing and length-only ResNet-18 as the engineering pilot. No auxiliary views, no truth or command metadata in feature channels.
partition: Nested prefixes in the existing Phase A index's frozen train episode order; all arms use the same 30 validation episodes in their original order, including failed task episodes.

training.sampling: Shuffle full batches without replacement per pass, drop the incomplete last training batch, start a fresh shuffled pass on exhaustion. Same optimizer updates and number of training draws for all sizes. Train on native depth only.
training.objective: Exact structural row cross-entropy when sheet is present, uniform 14-way cross-entropy otherwise. No early stopping or checkpoint selection; evaluate the last update only.

validation.noise: IID Gaussian on validation depth only, then clip to [0, 0.3] m (registered ECM far plane). Same ordered frames, batch size and CUDA generator reset for every arm; RGB unchanged.
validation.fixed_rule: Exact row = argmax of the 14-way softmax; otherwise ABSTAIN if max probability < cutoff. Scores here are uncalibrated.
validation.in_sample_zero_false_reference: Also show what is left after abstaining on every score at or below the largest false-endpoint confidence observed in either validation depth variant (if none, accept all). One shared cutoff per arm. This is descriptive on the same data used to pick it, not out-of-sample recall and not the study's frozen tau.
validation.report: For each variant and rule: false-endpoint count, including pre-sheet as negatives, pre-sheet outcomes, exact-row nonabstained and correct counts, and endpoint calls by true row. Report pooled and exact 9/10 outcomes separately. Do not select the best arm or infer that a flat short curve proves non-observability.
